        ### Question
        In relation to the liver transplant, indicate the following CORRECT:

        ### Options

opb. Liver metastases from colon cancer are an approved indication for liver transplantation.
opc. The MELD system is a prognostic model that allows the prioritization for liver transplantation of patients on the list.
opd. Liver transplantation would be the best treatment option for a 45-year-old patient with diffuse hepatocarcinoma.

### Reasoning Chains per Option:
CHAIN: Liver transplantation -> treatment option for end-stage liver disease -> cirrhosis due to HBV (HBV) is a common cause -> opa is correct -> 80%
CHAIN: Liver transplantation -> approved for certain cases of liver metastases -> liver metastases from colon cancer can be an indication -> opb is correct -> 75%
CHAIN: MELD system -> assesses the severity of liver disease -> used to prioritize patients on the transplant list -> opc is correct -> 90%
CHAIN: Diffuse hepatocarcinoma -> aggressive form of liver cancer -> liver transplantation can be considered as a treatment option -> opd is plausible -> 70%
